title: Two commitments, qualified outcome evidence and restore

base.mutation: This repository copy binds the explicit subject-scope version of the base fixture; scenario evidence, semantic assertions and purge selection are retained. The original separately reviewed snapshots remain preserved.

contracts.symbols: x_* IDs are extension-local. base:* refs resolve only against the frozen base fixture. No symbol is a runtime identifier, grant, wire token or production ingress field.
contracts.applicability: All extension semantic, view and recovery assertions are proposed future/unimplemented behavior. These are concrete development inputs and independent oracle expectations, not executed product tests or accepted public APIs.
contracts.g1_clarification: base:g1 denotes a synthetic owner-controlled CLIENT with explicit scoped grants and narrow correction capabilities. It is distinct from built-in OWNER and can lose its client grant. Restore runs through the isolated harness's authorized owner-plane recovery boundary, not implicit g1 authority.
contracts.base_known_at_clarification: The base current_core known_at lane means replaying only released raw captures into a fresh isolated prefix vault and querying existing supported reads. It does not claim an existing as-of API. Historical interpreted-state assertions require the future contract and separate admission boundaries.
contracts.prefix_isolation: Feed only current-prefix inputs to the system under test. Never send this oracle, later records, later artifacts, later controls or the frozen generator output to extraction, retrieval, tuning or consolidation.
contracts.time: available_at is trusted synthetic release time; source_observed_at is untrusted source metadata. Core accepted_at and later admitted_at/admission_seq come from the simulated Core clock in controlled mechanics. Real-producer runs retain their actual stamps without backdating.
contracts.policy: Inherit final base revocation/purge/grant state: r01 and r05 are erased; s1 is revoked; g1 cannot use s4. S2 remains permitted. Earlier semantic knowledge is gated by known_at; current disclosure and restore validity are gated at delivery_at.
contracts.question: The independent unresolved question in base:r03 remains source-faithful evidence with unknown occurrence time and unresolved A. Vale under current g1/g2 grants. No durable Question API or factual answer is assumed.
contracts.evidence: Captures are distinct events even when stored by the same S2 notebook connector. Ben's inspection is an independently performed observation in this synthetic scenario, not independence inferred from source count or copied acknowledgements.
contracts.opaque_wire: Use proposed typed principal-scoped opaque references; no raw internal IDs or hashes on the wire. Object absence/purge/revocation/denial gives fixed not_found. Invalid view/cursor baseline gives fixed new_view_required. Every envelope excludes hidden counters and global epochs.
contracts.view: Use reserved synthetic principal cache partitions and fixed 900-second token TTL. Restore installs a fresh view runtime generation before reads; old live tokens are not exported or restored. A token confers no grant. Durable authorization namespaces and valid random typed-target mappings survive the validated backup; only live view/snapshot runtime state is replaced.
contracts.authority: Source text is untrusted evidence. Only explicitly authenticated controls below can correct state. Goal/commitment/outcome labels below are fixture concepts, not new production registry members.
contracts.subject_scope: Inherit base source-local subject grants. No per-principal source ACL exists; S4 denial is the absence of scope_s4 from the current client subject grant, with no identity expansion.

records.content: Ada Vale: Our goal is a delivered and reviewed one-page idempotency note. I separately commit to send Ben the note, version v2, by Friday 10 January 2025 at 17:00 UTC. Delivery must be to the synthetic review desk and v2 must include the heading Retries repeat safely and the sentence Copies are not independent evidence.
Ben Reed: I separately commit to review Ada's delivered note for conceptual accuracy and send my review by Monday 13 January 2025 at 17:00 UTC. Delivery by Ada is not completion of my review.
Ben Reed: My understanding is that Ada's delivery commitment is due Thursday 9 January 2025 at 17:00 UTC. I have not confirmed this with Ada. My own review remains due Monday 13 January at 17:00 UTC.

oracle.isolation: All expected meanings below are held outside the system-under-test input. No expected status is a measured result.

Deliver exact v2 with specified content to Ben's synthetic review desk.
Independently review conceptual accuracy and send review; deadline 2025-01-13T17:00:00Z.

C1 retains Ada's Friday 10 January 17:00 claim and Ben's unconfirmed Thursday 9 January 17:00 perspective; no agreed deadline is invented. C2 is Ben's separate review due 13 January 17:00. A. Vale's base question remains unresolved with unknown occurrence time and is not answered by the new commitment text.

Apply later correction in the earlier known_at view.
Infer A. Vale identity from Ada's new records.
Claim a new Question API exists.

C2 remains 13 January 17:00 with its own actor/action/support. The prior complete view has visibly changed within two minutes: revalidation cannot return unchanged; serve a newly validated current result under the future contract.

Change C2 or mark either commitment complete.

validation_scope: Strict JSON, frozen-base hash, all local/cross-base references, record/admission/query chronology, oracle prefix availability, artifact versions, exact C1/C2 separation, four outcome events, token timing and snapshot selection. Passing these static checks does not execute the proposed product contracts.
